references.text: The economic escalation from collecting money to buying the entire country demonstrates the complete transfer of property rights to Pharaoh.
The verses form a coherent narrative unit where the collection of money (14) directly leads to the purchase of people and land (23).
41:56 establishes the grain sales as the action, while 47:14 details the economic consequence (money to Pharaoh) of this policy.
41:57 describes the global influx for grain, while 47:14 shows the economic mechanism that followed from this influx.
41:55 establishes the command to buy grain from Joseph, while 47:14 documents the actual execution and payment.
